Each draft's own explanation

Draft 1 - sampled
To both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer and the SGD 4.50 no-show fee is held rather than collected or refunded while that review is pending. Neither of you moves money today. On the trip itself, the driver's account is supported. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02727) shows the driver en route from 22:33, tapping 'I'm Here' at 22:40:11 and cancelling at 22:48:15 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02727) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 22:40:11 for one continuous 484-second run of 49 qualifying fixes. That satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d): arrival event present, geofence entry at that event, a 484-second dwell against the 180-second free waiting period, and termination under a recognised no-show code after the dwell elapsed. The arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05 (he was stationary at the pin, not driving past), POL-NS-06's shortfall rule has nothing to bite on, and POL-NS-03 does not apply because his fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it. The fare line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with the SGD 4.50 platform fee under POL-NS-08(d). The rider's exoneration route could not be run: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02727) holds a single driver message and none from the rider, and the rider's device sat roughly 700 m from the pin throughout, so POL-NS-04 fails at limbs (a) and (c). The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02727-01, weight 0.0) is not needed, because the dwell already exceeded the minimum. That would ordinarily mean the fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee (the money block's own driver_compensation figure). I cannot process it. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check trips on the driver's own trailing-30-day numbers: no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the test needs 4 or more) and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Those are the only two profile fields the clause reads; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter of 7 is context only under POL-GEN-01 and played no part. Compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Escalation is terminal and replaces any monetary outcome. The driver's request that the charge simply stand (POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION) is displaced: NO_ACTION would leave the rider charged, whereas escalation holds the fee. The rider's request for a refund is not granted now either. POL-NS-07 directs the escalation packet to instruct the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.50 cancellation fee in full, and that instruction is recorded as a referral; the SGD 4.50 stays frozen meanwhile. The reviewer must settle one open question: whether the driver's four no-show terminations in the last 30 days at a 0.10 rate reflect fee-farming, in which case the rider's fee is refunded in full, or whether this trip was a genuine no-show that the pattern alone should not distort. My confidence is 0.9; every artifact this finding rests on carries a weight multiplier of 1.0, so nothing is discounted and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0.
Draft 2 - sampled
To the rider, and to the driver: this case is escalated to a human reviewer. No money moves on the automated pipeline: your $4.50 stays held, neither collected nor refunded, until review. Per POL-NS-07 the reviewer is instructed to refund the $4.50 to the rider in full. On the underlying no-show, the driver's account is made out on this record. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02727) shows the driver tap 'I'm Here' at 22:40:11 and the trip terminated by the driver at 22:48:15 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02727) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 22:40:11 - a single qualifying in-geofence run of 49 fixes lasting 484 seconds, minimum distance to the pin 0.0 m - so the dwell of 484 s comfortably exceeds the 180 s free waiting period in force. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. POL-NS-05 finds no false arrival marker: the marker coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and even recomputed the dwell still meets the minimum. POL-NS-06 has nothing to bite on (shortfall -304 s). POL-NS-03 is not engaged, the driver being inside the radius rather than at a wrong face of the venue within 400 m. POL-NS-08(d) is satisfied: the fare line of $4.50 reconciles with the platform_policy figure of $4.50, so no fare defect excuses the charge. The rider is not exonerated by POL-NS-04. Limb (a) fails - the chat log (EV-CHAT-02727) holds one message, the driver's 'im at the pickup point' at 22:40:31, and nothing from the rider - and limb (c) is affirmatively failed, not undecidable: the rider track is present with 83 fixes and 0 of them within the 100 m presence radius, the device sitting roughly 700 m from the pin. The traffic advisory is absent (EV-ADVIS-02727-01, weight 0.0) but carries no deciding fact here: POL-NS-06(i) never had to be run, because this was a single continuous in-geofence dwell, not separate intervals to be summed. The judge's explanation, verbatim

To both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer and the SGD 4.50 no-show fee is held rather than collected or refunded while that review is pending. Neither of you moves money today. On the trip itself, the driver's account is supported. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02727) shows the driver en route from 22:33, tapping 'I'm Here' at 22:40:11 and cancelling at 22:48:15 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02727) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 22:40:11 for one continuous 484-second run of 49 qualifying fixes. That satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d): arrival event present, geofence entry at that event, a 484-second dwell against the 180-second free waiting period, and termination under a recognised no-show code after the dwell elapsed. The arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05 (he was stationary at the pin, not driving past), POL-NS-06's shortfall rule has nothing to bite on, and POL-NS-03 does not apply because his fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it. The fare line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with the SGD 4.50 platform fee under POL-NS-08(d). The rider's exoneration route could not be run: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02727) holds a single driver message and none from the rider, and the rider's device sat roughly 700 m from the pin throughout, so POL-NS-04 fails at limbs (a) and (c). The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02727-01, weight 0.0) is not needed, because the dwell already exceeded the minimum. That would ordinarily mean the fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee (the money block's own driver_compensation figure). I cannot process it. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check trips on the driver's own trailing-30-day numbers: no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the test needs 4 or more) and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Those are the only two profile fields the clause reads; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter of 7 is context only under POL-GEN-01 and played no part. Compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Escalation is terminal and replaces any monetary outcome. The driver's request that the charge simply stand (POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION) is displaced: NO_ACTION would leave the rider charged, whereas escalation holds the fee. The rider's request for a refund is not granted now either. POL-NS-07 directs the escalation packet to instruct the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.50 cancellation fee in full, and that instruction is recorded as a referral; the SGD 4.50 stays frozen meanwhile. The reviewer must settle one open question: whether the driver's four no-show terminations in the last 30 days at a 0.10 rate reflect fee-farming, in which case the rider's fee is refunded in full, or whether this trip was a genuine no-show that the pattern alone should not distort. My confidence is 0.9; every artifact this finding rests on carries a weight multiplier of 1.0, so nothing is discounted and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

    • Limb (d) is met: the record shows no boarding event, the trip was terminated by the driver at 2026-09-07T22:48:15+08:00 - 484 seconds after the dwell began - and the cancellation is recorded under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, so the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable. kept

That clause decides a driver stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the driver's fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, the minimum distance to the pin across the derived driver track being 0.0 m. This is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case, and no goodwill payment or rider refund follows from it. kept
    • There is no fare defect to excuse the charge. The amount the rider contests is the amount the schedule fixes. kept
    • With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee - SGD 3.60, which is the money block's own computed driver_compensation figure. I disclose the one qualification on this record: both limbs of the anti-farming check are met (no_show_terminations_30d is 4, and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, above 0.08), so compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). That is a routing consequence of the checker, not a finding that this trip was a farmed no-show, and escalation holds the fee rather than refunding it: this trip's own evidence - a 484 second continuous dwell inside a 50 m radius, a single unanswered driver message, and a rider device stationary some 700 m from the pin - describes a genuine no-show. kept
    • Whatever the routing of the compensation question, the rider's claim to have the SGD 4.50 returned is not supported on this evidence: no rider-exonerating clause of the no-show policy applies, so no refund is licensed.
